tasks.subject: Task 1: List parsing and watched-planning (`proxer-parse`)
Task 2: Client POST and Tauri commands
Task 3: Frontend API, demo fakes and helpers
Task 4: My list row, title actions, watchlist buttons
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Home "My list" row first; Title hero Note/Favorite/Finished wired with list-state chip and message line; EpisodePicker Watchlist buttons wired. **Files:** - Modify: `src/lib/Home.svelte` - Modify: `src/lib/ui/PosterRow.svelte`, `src/lib/ui/Poster.svelte` - Modify: `src/lib/Title.svelte` - Modify: `src/lib/ui/EpisodePicker.svelte` **Acceptance Criteria:** - [ ] Home rows in order: My list, Airing now, Top rated, Most viewed; My list badge shows `episode/total`; the hero is still the first Airing hit; empty My list hides. - [ ] Title meta ends with e.g. `Am Schauen · 3/12` when the title is in the list. - [ ] Note shows `aria-pressed="true"` for state 2, Finished for state 0; after an action Proxer's message shows in a `role="status"` line, errors in the existing alert; the list state reloads after success. - [ ] Watchlist buttons call `api.reminder(id, selected.ep, selected.lang, "this"|"next")` and show the message the same way. - [ ] No action button is ever `disabled` while busy (TV focus); a second click while busy is ignored. - [ ] Demo screenshot `?demo&screen=title&id=59782&pick=1` shows the chip and enabled buttons. **Verify:** `npm run check` → 0 errors 0 warnings; `npm test` → pass **Steps:** - [ ] **Step 1: Poster badge.** `Poster.svelte`: type `rating?: number | string | null` (it is only displayed). `PosterRow.svelte`: pass `rating={h.badge ?? h.rating}`. - [ ] **Step 2: Home.** In `Home.svelte`: `type Row = { kind: ListKind | "mine"; ... }`; prepend `{ kind: "mine", title: "My list", status: "loading", hits: [], error: "" }`; hero becomes `rows.find((r) => r.kind === "airing")?.hits[0] ?? null`; in `load`: ```ts try { r.hits = r.kind === "mine" ? myListHits(await api.myList()) : (await api.getList(r.kind)).hits; r.status = "ready"; } ``` (import `myListHits` from `./ui/helpers`). - [ ] **Step 3: Title.** Add state and helpers (import `type ListEntry`, `type TitleAction` from `./api`): ```ts const STATES = ["Geschaut", "Am Schauen", "Wird noch geschaut", "Abgebrochen"]; let entry = $state(null), message = $state(""), busy = false; async function loadEntry() { const cur = id; try { const l = await api.myList(); if (cur === id) entry = l.find((e) => e.id === cur) ?? null; } catch (x) { if (x === "NotLoggedIn") onauth(); } // the chip is optional: the page stays usable without it } /** Run a write; show Proxer's message, refresh the list state. Buttons stay enabled (TV focus), so guard re-entry. */ async function act(run: () => Promise) { if (busy) return; busy = true; message = ""; error = ""; try { message = (await run()) || "Done"; await loadEntry(); } catch (x) { fail(x); } busy = false; } const titleAct = (a: TitleAction) => act(() => api.titleAction(id, a)); ``` In the `$effect` after `await loadPage(1);` add `loadEntry();` (not awaited). Reset `entry = null; message = "";` at the start of the effect (when `id` changes). `meta` becomes: ```ts const meta = $derived([info?.fields["Status"], info?.fields["Genre"], entry && `${STATES[entry.state] ?? ""} · ${entry.episode}/${entry.episodes || "?"}`].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")); ``` Replace the disabled `{#each ["Note", "Favorite", "Finished"] ...}` with: ```svelte ``` After ``: `{#if message}

{message}

{/if}`. Pass `onreminder={(w) => { const s = selected; if (s) act(() => api.reminder(id, s.ep, s.lang, w)); }}` to `EpisodePicker`. Styles: ```css .msg { padding: 8px var(--pad) 0; color: var(--muted); } button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--good); color: #fff; } ``` - [ ] **Step 4: EpisodePicker.** Add prop `onreminder: (which: "this" | "next") => void`; the two Watchlist buttons lose `disabled`/`title` and get `onclick={() => onreminder("this")}` / `onclick={() => onreminder("next")}`. - [ ] **Step 5: Check** `npm run check`, `npm test`, `npm run build`; demo screenshots (dev server `npx vite --port 1420 --strictPort`; kill it afterwards with `pkill -f "[n]ode.*vite"`): `google-chrome-stable --headless=new --disable-gpu --hide-scrollbars --window-size=1280,900 --virtual-time-budget=6000 --screenshot=/t4-title.png "http://localhost:1420/?demo&screen=title&id=59782&pick=1"` and `...?demo&screen=home` → the chip "Am Schauen · 3/12" and the My list row are visible. - [ ] **Step 6: Commit** ```bash git add src/lib git commit -m "feat(ui): My list row, title actions and watchlist buttons wired" ``` ```json:metadata {"files": ["src/lib/Home.svelte", "src/lib/ui/PosterRow.svelte", "src/lib/ui/Poster.svelte", "src/lib/Title.svelte", "src/lib/ui/EpisodePicker.svelte"], "verifyCommand": "npm run check && npm test && npm run build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["row order and badge", "meta chip", "pressed states and message line", "reminder wiring", "no disabled while busy"], "modelTier": "standard"} ```
